up: Count the number of molecules grouped by their maximum development phase. Use the max_phase column from the molecule_dictionary table. sql: SELECT max_phase, COUNT(molregno) AS molecule_count FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY max_phase ORDER BY max_phase ASC
